title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI quality gates and metrics integration (CI hooks)
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds per-prompt CI hooks to run eval-harness metrics and fail builds on prompt-set regressions; configurable thresholds and opt-outs for flaky prompts
body: Summary: Adds per-prompt CI hooks and metrics integration for the eval-harness so that pull requests run gated checks against a configurable prompt set and fail when defined quality thresholds regress. Motivation: We need earlier detection of prompt-level regressions to prevent production quality drops when model or prompt changes are introduced; this PR implements a lightweight CI integration that runs a cached subset of evals, reports per-prompt metrics, and fails the job when thresholds are crossed. Changes included: 1) new CI job .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml that runs on PRs for affected prompt sets; 2) eval-harness/ci_hooks.py: orchestration and cache-aware runner with configurable timeouts and batching; 3) eval-harness/metrics/reporting.py: CI-oriented reporter that emits machine-readable failures and summary HTML; 4) tests/eval/integration/test_per_prompt_ci.py: integration tests and a small local runner; 5) docs/eval/per-prompt-quality-gates.md: usage and configuration guide; 6) examples/ci/prompt-gates.example.yaml: example threshold config; 7) minor tweaks to eval-harness/config/defaults.yaml to add per-prompt gating options. Commit summary: - 1a2b3c4: initial ci_hooks runner and basic reporter; - 2b3c4d5: add GitHub Actions workflow and example config; - 3c4d5e6: add integration tests and mock metrics backend; - 4d5e6f7: docs and examples; - 5e6f7g8: test fixes and CI flake handling. Files changed (high level): eval-harness/ci_hooks.py, eval-harness/metrics/reporting.py, .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml, tests/eval/integration/test_per_prompt_ci.py, docs/eval/per-prompt-quality-gates.md, examples/ci/prompt-gates.example.yaml, eval-harness/config/defaults.yaml, small updates to CI bootstrap script. Tests and CI: The PR adds a new lightweight action that runs a subset of evals (target ~20 prompts) using a cached model snapshot on PRs that touch prompts or eval code; the workflow also supports a manual rerun and experimental matrix for model variants. CI results: initial run had flake on macOS runner which was fixed in follow-up; final CI status is pass. Review conversation (high level): - Miguel: asked for clearer failure messages and ability to opt-out noisy prompts; author implemented per-prompt ignore list and improved reporter to include failure diffs. - Sofia: requested telemetry dimensions to be included for easier aggregation; updated reporter to emit per-prompt metric tags and added tests. - Priya: asked about impact on PR latency; added caching, incremental run mode, and an allowlist so only PRs touching prompt files trigger full runs. Approvals: Miguel approved after fixes; Sofia approved after telemetry changes; Priya approved pending performance notes which were addressed. Risk and rollout: Default threshold is conservative; feature gated behind eval-harness.ci.per_prompt.enabled in defaults.yaml and disabled for legacy repos by default. Opt-out: a per-directory .evalci-ignore can be committed to skip known flaky prompts. Follow-ups: - Integrate with Console's dashboard for per-prompt historical trends (ENG-2045) - Add automatic alerting on sustained regressions (ENG-1423) Merge: Squash-merged to main after green CI and approvals; release notes added to changelog. Checklist: - [x] Tests added - [x] CI job added - [x] Docs updated - [x] Linear tickets linked
comments: Miguel Torres (reviewer): Please include the specific failure payload that the reporter emits so SRE can wire alerts; current message is too terse. Asha: Added structured JSON failure payload and sample schema in reporting.py and docs.

Sofia Nguyen (reviewer): Can we tag metrics with model/commit so cross-PR aggregation works? Asha: Updated reporter to include model_name, model_commit, runner_id and added tests in test_per_prompt_ci.py.

Priya Raman (reviewer): How much extra latency for the standard PR? If prompts change often we might overload CI. Asha: Implemented lazy mode and changed workflow trigger to only run full per-prompt on files matching ^eval|^prompts; added cache and incremental run mode, expecting median extra time ~3-7 minutes on most PRs.
CI Bot: macOS runner flake detected during first run (timeout on test_per_prompt_ci); rerun fixed after increasing timeout and using smaller matrix. Final CI status: pass.
Release Manager (comment): Please ensure docs include example of how to set conservative thresholds; added docs/eval/per-prompt-quality-gates.md with examples.
